question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date,
        SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.payment_date,
        p.amount,
        cs.first_payment_date,
        cs.total_ltv,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cs.first_payment_date)) as seconds_after_first
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_stats cs ON p.customer_id = cs.customer_id
),
time_windows AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        total_ltv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN seconds_after_first <= 604800 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_7_days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN seconds_after_first <= 2592000 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_30_days
    FROM customer_payments
    GROUP BY customer_id, total_ltv
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(total_ltv), 2) as avg_ltv,
    ROUND(AVG(ltv_7_days / total_ltv * 100), 2) as avg_pct_7_days,
    ROUND(AVG(ltv_30_days / total_ltv * 100), 2) as avg_pct_30_days
FROM time_windows

WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date,
        SUM(amount) as total_ltv

),
customer_payments AS (

),
time_windows AS (
    SELECT

        SUM(CASE WHEN hours_after_first <= 168 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_7_days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN hours_after_first <= 720 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_30_days
    FROM customer_payments
    GROUP BY customer_id, total_ltv
)
SELECT 
    AVG(total_ltv) as avg_ltv,
    AVG(ltv_7_days / total_ltv * 100) as avg_pct_7_days,
    AVG(ltv_30_days / total_ltv * 100) as avg_pct_30_days
FROM time_windows
